newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM plunges into the red in third quarter.
newsitem.headline: KLM plunges into the red in third quarter.

text.p: Dutch flag carrier KLM Royal Dutch Airlines plunged into the red on Tuesday, reporting a third quarter 1996/97 loss of seven million guilders against a 102 million profit in the previous year.
The airline also reported a third quarter operating loss of 19 million guilders, down from a 56 million profit.
The results take nine-month net profits to 522 million, down from 539 million in the same year-ago period.
It maintained its earlier forecast that full-year net profits for 1996/97 would be some 150 million guilders lower than in the previous year.

Analysts had expected profits at the airline to nosedive, as spiralling fuel and other costs took their toll. Estimates ranged from an operating loss of 25 million guilders to a 35 million guilder profit.
KLM shares were down one guilder at 53.50 guilders within minutes of the results being released.
